title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.00636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. translated_title: CompMat-Bench：面向计算材料科学的AI智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 在科学研究任务上评估AI智能体受到底层实验或计算所需时间和资源的限制。在计算材料研究中，跨智能体和多次试验重复相同的昂贵模拟会使评估变得不切实际。我们提出了CompMat-Bench，这是一个包含94个任务的基准，这些任务源自近期发表的计算材料研究，每个任务要求智能体完成实现该研究科学目标的一个步骤。我们预先复现了研究步骤，并评估智能体在为昂贵模拟准备输入和分析输出方面的能力，从而在评估过程中避免执行昂贵的模拟。复现的输入和结果作为基准真值，通过固定规则对智能体进行评分，无需LLM裁判。该基准支持四种评估条件：单一任务和由相关任务组成的工作流，每种条件均提供完整或精简的方法学指导。
tldr: 提出了CompMat-Bench基准，通过预先复现昂贵模拟的输入与结果作为固定规则的评分依据，实现对计算材料科学AI智能体的低成本高效评估，涵盖94个源自已发表研究的任务以及四种评估条件。
en_tdlr: CompMat-Bench is a 94-task benchmark for evaluating AI agents in computational materials science, which avoids running expensive simulations during evaluation by pre-reproducing inputs and outputs as ground truth for fixed-rule grading across four evaluation conditions.
